main.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with {{years}}+ years of experience designing, building and maintaining web, API and mobile products for healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, recruitment and government clients. Currently developing a HIPAA-compliant healthcare (EHR) platform with Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript and Next.js, and founder of SweetCharts.com, a trading-chart analysis platform built with Django, React, Redis and the Binance and BingX APIs. Strong background in REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices on AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2), relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) and payment integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Conekta). Daily user of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode) and builder of MCP servers, agent skills and LLM-powered features. Comfortable owning Full Stack features, from data model to UI, in remote, English-speaking teams.
main.bio: I am a Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience developing software with technologies such as: Ruby on Rails, ReactJS, TypeScript, NextJS, NodeJS, Django/Python, Ionic, AngularJS, JavaScript, PHP, jQuery, AWS Lambda, AWS EC2, AWS S3, AWS Alexa, ElasticSearch, DynamoDB, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, CSS3, GIT. Other skills: Stripe, Unit Testing, PayPal, Conekta, Swagger, Material, Bootstrap, HTML5, Sass, Less.
main.contactmessage: Contact me if you have any question.
main.title_es: Ingeniero de Software Full Stack Senior
main.headline_es: Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript · Node.js · Python/Django · AWS · Herramientas de IA (Claude Code, MCP)
main.summary_es: Ingeniero de Software Full Stack con más de {{years}} años de experiencia diseñando, construyendo y manteniendo productos web, API y móviles para clientes de salud, fintech, comercio electrónico, reclutamiento y gobierno. Actualmente desarrollo una plataforma de salud (EHR) que cumple con HIPAA usando Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript y Next.js, y soy fundador de SweetCharts.com, una plataforma de análisis de gráficos de trading construida con Django, React, Redis y las APIs de Binance y BingX. Sólida experiencia en APIs REST y GraphQL, microservicios en AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2), bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) e integraciones de pago (Stripe, PayPal, Conekta). Usuario diario de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode) y creador de servidores MCP, agent skills y funcionalidades basadas en LLM. Cómodo asumiendo funcionalidades Full Stack completas, desde el modelo de datos hasta la UI, en equipos remotos de habla inglesa.

work.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
work.description: FullStack development for health software HIPAA compliance, using tools such as Ruby on Rails, React, Typescript, NextJS, SQL, Third-party API software, among others.
highlights: Full Stack development and maintenance of a HIPAA-compliant healthcare (EHR) platform, from database and API design to UI.
Build backend services and REST APIs with Ruby on Rails and SQL, and front-end features with React, TypeScript and Next.js.
Integrate third-party APIs and services into the platform, following healthcare data-protection requirements.
highlights_es: Desarrollo y mantenimiento Full Stack de una plataforma de salud (EHR) que cumple con HIPAA, desde el diseño de base de datos y APIs hasta la UI.
Construyo servicios backend y APIs REST con Ruby on Rails y SQL, y funcionalidades front-end con React, TypeScript y Next.js.
Integro APIs y servicios de terceros en la plataforma, siguiendo los requisitos de protección de datos de salud.

work.title: Founder & Lead Full Stack Developer
work.description: Owner and developer of SweetCharts.com, a platform to analyze trading charts with different strategies, built with Django, React, Redis and the Binance and BingX APIs.
highlights: Full Stack owner of the whole product: architecture, backend, front end, infrastructure and releases of a platform that analyzes trading charts against multiple strategies, so users avoid spending hours per symbol.
Built the backend with Django and Django REST Framework, using Redis for caching and background processing of market data.
Integrated the Binance and BingX exchange APIs to ingest market data across symbols and timeframes, and built the React (Next.js) front end to visualize charts and strategy results.
work.title_es: Fundador y Desarrollador Full Stack Principal
highlights_es: Responsable Full Stack de todo el producto: arquitectura, backend, front end, infraestructura y despliegues de una plataforma que analiza gráficos de trading con múltiples estrategias, para que los usuarios no pasen horas por cada símbolo.
Construí el backend con Django y Django REST Framework, usando Redis para caché y procesamiento en segundo plano de datos de mercado.

Integré las APIs de los exchanges Binance y BingX para ingerir datos de mercado de múltiples símbolos y temporalidades, y construí el front end en React (Next.js) para visualizar gráficos y resultados de estrategias.

work.title: Software Developer
work.description: Development of applications for FurstPerson, Stovell, MyNLU, Horoscope, among others, with +3B$ clients like Apple, Discovery Channel, Facebook Messenger Chatbot among others. Working with Microservices strategy, Web, API and Alexa using tools like NodeJs, ReactJs, Python, Ruby on Rails, AWS Lambda functions, AWS ASK, AWS S3, MongoDB.
highlights: Delivered web, API and voice (Alexa) applications for clients such as FurstPerson, Stovell, MyNLU and Horoscope, whose end customers include Apple, Discovery Channel and Facebook.
Built microservices with Node.js, Python and Ruby on Rails deployed on AWS Lambda, using AWS S3 and MongoDB for storage.
Developed Alexa skills with the Alexa Skills Kit (AWS ASK), a Facebook Messenger chatbot and React front ends.
highlights_es: Entregué aplicaciones web, API y de voz (Alexa) para clientes como FurstPerson, Stovell, MyNLU y Horoscope, cuyos clientes finales incluyen Apple, Discovery Channel y Facebook.
Construí microservicios con Node.js, Python y Ruby on Rails desplegados en AWS Lambda, usando AWS S3 y MongoDB como almacenamiento.
Desarrollé skills de Alexa con el Alexa Skills Kit (AWS ASK), un chatbot de Facebook Messenger y front ends en React.

work.title: Full Stack & Mobile Developer
work.description: Flyers Concierge (Angular/Ionic), CoinNotification (Angular/Ionic) app to receive notifications according to the cryptocurrency configuration, Guaruras (Angular/Ionic) app for GPS tracking for personal security, ReadImage (Angular/Ionic) project to read the content from image documents, Cargapp (AngularJS/Ionic) project for trucks and freight in Colombia, CombateObesidad (AngularJS/Ionic) app to lose weight with coaches, LeyApp (AngularJS/Ionic) an application for lawyers and clients in Colombia, Legalitas web application for attorneys, and more applications, GISAGA (Joomla/PHP) survey application.
highlights: Published hybrid mobile apps with Ionic and Angular: CoinNotification (cryptocurrency price alerts), Guaruras (GPS tracking for personal security), Flyers Concierge and ReadImage (document image reading).
Built Ionic/AngularJS apps for the Colombian market: Cargapp (trucking and freight), CombateObesidad (weight loss with coaches) and LeyApp (lawyers and clients).
Developed web applications such as Legalitas (attorney services) and GISAGA (survey platform on Joomla/PHP).
highlights_es: Publiqué apps móviles híbridas con Ionic y Angular: CoinNotification (alertas de precios de criptomonedas), Guaruras (rastreo GPS para seguridad personal), Flyers Concierge y ReadImage (lectura de documentos en imágenes).
Construí apps Ionic/AngularJS para el mercado colombiano: Cargapp (transporte de carga), CombateObesidad (pérdida de peso con coaches) y LeyApp (abogados y clientes).
Desarrollé aplicaciones web como Legalitas (servicios de abogados) y GISAGA (plataforma de encuestas en Joomla/PHP).
